gloss: poetry anthology; collection of poems or songs

definitions.gloss: poetry anthology; collection of poems or songs
definitions.explanation: A book that collects poems—especially {短歌|たんか} and other Japanese verse—or songs. In classical literature it refers to anthologies of waka such as the {万葉集|まんようしゅう}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{歌集|かしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: to read an old poetry anthology.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歌集|かしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She published her own poetry collection.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{歌集|かしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{四季|しき}→四季：11809_shiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詠|よ}んだ→詠む：14186_yomu⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{短歌|たんか}→短歌：15358_tanka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{収|おさ}められている→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
examples.english: This anthology contains beautiful tanka composed about the four seasons.

notes:
Combines {歌|か} (song, poem) + {集|しゅう} (collection). A collected book of poems—especially ⟦{短歌|たんか}→短歌：15358_tanka⟧ and other Japanese verse—or of songs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和歌集|わかしゅう}: anthology of waka poetry
- {歌集|かしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧: to compile a poetry anthology
- ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧{歌集|かしゅう}: a personal poetry collection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {詩集|ししゅう}: poetry collection — for ⟦{詩|し}→詩：02139_shi⟧ (free verse, modern poetry) rather than traditional ⟦{短歌|たんか}→短歌：15358_tanka⟧
- {句集|くしゅう}: haiku collection — specifically for ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧
